The work addresses layer depth as a structural inefficiency and bottleneck, proposing to remove redundant deep layers to create smaller models, which relates to the concept of layer depth as a primary bottleneck for model capacity and efficiency.

The proposed 'Inheritune' method is a training strategy that involves progressive training and expansion after inheriting early layers, which matches the description of 'progressive stacking' and 'curriculum-based compression' for optimizing model structure.
